{{Quote|Good thing, too, eh? Come only to you with it! Worth plenty creds, yes?|Niffla, to Dru Valan|<ref name="Legacy 20" />}}
'''Niffla''' was a [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]]<ref name="LECG" /> [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]]. In [[137 ABY]], she sold information to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Dru Valan]] about [[Gial Gahan]]'s part in [[Gar Stazi]]'s plan to capture the [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']], an [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]] that was under construction at the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]]. She also informed Valan that Gahan's niece, [[Monia Gahan|Monia]], was a pilot in the famed [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]. Valan ordered Niffla to be confined to the brig of his [[Relentless (Pellaeon-class)|ship]] to avoid her leaking the information to anyone else.<ref name="Legacy 20" />
